date.description: The date that shows up on the article. Typically the original published date.

publish_at.description: Date when this page be will be visible on the site. If this is not set then the article will not appear on the site.

exclude_from_sitemap.description: When enabled will exclude this page from the sitemap.xml file.

exclude_from_internal_search.description: When enabled will exclude this page from the internal site search. External Search will be unaffected.

robots_no_index.description:
When enabled will add a meta tag to the page asking search engine crawlers not to crawl the page.
https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/robots-meta-tag

robots_no_follow.description:
Asks search engine crawlers not to use the links on this page to discover other linked pages.
https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/robots-meta-tag

redirect_url.description: When specified this page will redirect the user to the specified URL instead of loading this page.

alternate_urls.description: The specified URL's will create a 301 redirect to this page. ( Limit 10 )

schema.description:

https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/sd-policies
